name: groups-and-xfail
comment: Showcases the 0.11 reporting features on a self-contained scratch buffer: a params template default (the 'greeting' variable), named groups (run reports 'insert: PASS · mode: PASS · known-broken: XFAIL'), comparison/regex assert operators, and an xfail (a known failure that does not fail the run). Override the template with `elate run examples/groups-and-xfail.json --set greeting=hi`, or add axes with `elate matrix ... --param greeting=hello,hi`.

steps.reason: demo: a known failure is reported xfail, not a run failure
